core_problem_solved: To provide a pure-Java library for building elegant, easy-to-read parsers for formal languages directly in Java code, without an external grammar definition file, based on Parsing Expression Grammars (PEGs).
key_features: Defining grammars directly and fluently in Java code
Support for creating an Abstract Syntax Tree (AST) from the parse
Good error reporting and debugging capabilities for grammars
era_and_niche: An innovative parsing library, popular with developers who preferred defining grammars in pure code over using a separate grammar file and a code generation step (like ANTLR).
reason_for_obsolescence: This specific library, `parboiled-java` for Java 6/7, is **obsolete and no longer maintained**. The project was completely rewritten as **Parboiled 2**, which is written in Scala but offers full Java compatibility and leverages modern language features. The official successor is the Parboiled 2 artifact (e.g., `org.parboiled:parboiled_2.12`).
